note: StegVerse-Labs/.github#3195, Option A of comment 6484539587: WORKER-TASK-RESOURCE-COST-LINKAGE-001's aggregate row diverges from its standalone record in blockers, expected_evidence_predicates and allowed_next_transitions; the record is correct. This request restores the row to the record and changes no record. It is the first of two: gen322-dependency-blocker-shape-normalization.v1.json applies after it (322 -> 323). row_fields.rationale: Option A of #3195 (comment 6484539587): the standalone record is correct and the aggregate row is restored to it. 9c48a6e8 (#2679, gen 247->248) removed blocker COSV_DERIVATION_AFTER_AUTHENTIC_ADMISSION and replaced predicate COSV_DERIVED_FROM_ADMITTED_REGISTRY_STATE -> COSV_SOURCE_STATE_TRACKING_VERIFIED_IN_CANONICAL_INDEX and transition DERIVE_CANONICAL_COSV -> UPDATE_COSV_ON_AUTHENTIC_STATE_EVIDENCE in both row and record. 770af692 (gen 249->250) reverted only the row's three COSV fields with no authorizing transition (a rebase artifact); the record was never reverted, and control/task-vectors/WORKER-TASK-RESOURCE-COST-LINKAGE-001.json records blocker_count 2. This request restores the row to the record: ['blockers'] takes the record's two strings, expected_evidence_predicates[4] and allowed_next_transitions[3] take the record's values; each is a no-op on the record, which already equals after. Blocker shape normalization is left to the follow-up request.
